evals.name: analytics-dashboard-desktop
evals.prompt: I'm building a self-hosted, privacy-friendly web analytics tool. I need the main dashboard: visitors over time, top pages, referrers, countries, devices, and a realtime 'people online now' counter. Show me a few layout options before I build it.
evals.expected_output: One self-contained v1.html with 2-4 genuinely different dashboard layouts (not colour swaps), plausible analytics numbers, per-variant notes with tradeoffs, some motion or interaction, and a closing question. No production code.
assertions: v1.html is one self-contained file: no external scripts or stylesheets apart from at most one Google Fonts link
v1.html has 2 to 4 <section class="dp-variant"> elements, each with an id, a data-name and a .dp-variant-notes block
The variants differ in layout structure or interaction model, not only in colours or fonts
The content is plausible analytics data (page paths, referrer domains, countries, numbers); no lorem ipsum or placeholder text
Every variant's notes state its tradeoffs, with at least one downside
At least one variant has a transition or animation utility (transition-*, animate-*, active:scale-*), and it has a motion-reduce: fallback or animates only on press
The final message gives the path of v1.html and ends with a question asking the user to choose or comment
No production code is written outside the proposal's folder

evals.name: bulk-actions-existing-codebase
evals.prompt: In questo progetto (billing-app) la pagina Fatture, src/pages/Invoices.tsx, mostra le azioni di massa (segna come pagata, invia sollecito, esporta, annulla) in una riga sopra la tabella che compare quando selezioni qualcosa, e fa saltare giù tutta la tabella. Fammi vedere delle alternative per dove mettere le azioni di massa, prima di toccare il codice.
evals.expected_output: A proposal about one part of an existing screen: the invoices page is written once as a shared context, each variant holds only the bulk-actions part, and the project's own Tailwind theme (including its dark theme) is used. Ends with a question; the project's source is untouched.
assertions: v1.html contains exactly one <template class="dp-context"> with the invoices page (search, status filter, table) and at least one <slot>
The invoices table markup is written once, in context.html, and not repeated in the variant fragments
Each variant fragment contains only its bulk-actions part and its notes, or opts out with data-context="none" because it restructures the page
head.html carries the project's theme from src/app.css: the @theme inline block and the :root and .dark variables, so classes such as bg-background, border-border and text-muted-foreground resolve
head.html has no @import or @plugin line
<body> has data-theme, so the light/dark toggle is available
The rows show plausible invoices (numbers, customer names, dates, amounts, statuses)
Every variant's notes state its tradeoffs
The final message ends with a question, and no file under billing-app/ was modified

evals.name: booking-mobile-web
evals.prompt: sto facendo il sito di prenotazione per una catena di barberie: dal telefono il cliente sceglie sede, servizio, barbiere e orario e poi conferma. è un sito, non un'app, e quasi tutti arrivano da un link su instagram. come lo imposteresti? voglio vedere delle alternative
evals.expected_output: A mobile-first web proposal: 2-4 alternative booking flows (for example stepper, single scrolling page, conversational) opening in the phone frame with Safari's chrome, showing the steps that matter, with realistic Italian content, transitions between steps, tradeoffs, and a closing question.
assertions: <body> has data-default-frame="mobile" and a data-url, and does not have data-chrome="app"
v1.html has 2 to 4 variants that differ in flow structure, not only in styling
The variants do not use h-[100vh], popover or <dialog>.showModal(), which would escape the phone frame
The content is realistic and in Italian (shop locations, services with prices and durations, barber names, time slots)
At least one step change or selection in each variant is interactive and animated with a transition, with a motion-reduce: fallback
Every variant's notes state its tradeoffs
The final message ends with a question asking the user to choose or comment, and no production code is written

evals.name: round-2-mix
evals.prompt: La cartella inbox-round1 è la cartella di lavoro di una proposta già arrivata al round 1 (head.html, context.html, a.html, b.html, c.html; il v1.html l'ho già visto). Mi piacciono i chip nella toolbar di A, ma per i filtri avanzati vorrei il drawer di C che si apre da un pulsante accanto ai chip. Fammi il round 2.
evals.expected_output: A new fragment that combines A's chips with C's drawer inside the shared context, assembled first into v2.html with A and C kept as reference tabs. head.html and context.html are unchanged, the mix's notes list what changed, and the message ends with a question.
assertions: v2.html exists in the working folder and its first <section class="dp-variant"> is a new variant with its own id
The new variant uses the shared context: it fills the toolbar slot with the chips and a button, and does not repeat the sidebar or the page header
The drawer in the new variant opens and closes from that button, with a transition
v2.html still contains variants A and C as reference tabs
head.html is byte-identical to the round 1 file: the round label is not written into it
The new variant's notes have a Changes section
The final message ends with a question

evals.name: finalise-approved-variant
evals.prompt: La cartella inbox-round1 è la cartella di lavoro di una proposta al round 1 (head.html, context.html, a.html, b.html, c.html). Approvo la B così com'è: chiudi la proposta.
evals.expected_output: final.html assembled from head.html, context.html and b.html only, and a report in Italian with the decision, the spec, a motion table or an explicit 'none', implementation notes, and the path of final.html. No production code; an offer to implement next.
assertions: final.html exists and contains exactly one <section class="dp-variant">, variant B, together with the shared context template
The report is in Italian and names the chosen variant and what was rejected
The report has a spec: layout structure, components, tokens (colours, type, spacing, radii), interactions and states
The report covers motion and interaction, as a table or as an explicit statement that the design has none
The report gives the path of final.html
No production code is written; the message offers to implement next
